name: scope.js
description: A tool for handling data transformations

scripts.check: node --check lib/vm/index.js && node --check lib/compiler/index.js && node --check lib/build/config-builder.js && node --check bin/transform.js && node --check bin/build-example.js && node --check bin/build-web.js && node --check bin/dev-server.js
scripts.complexity: rm -rf complexity.* && find lib/ | grep .js | xargs ./node_modules/.bin/cr --format plain --output complexity.txt
scripts.docs: jsdoc -r lib/ -r client/ -d docs && open docs/index.html

author: Jacob Mather
